capabilities: Pin sticky headers for expanded folders in the file explorer
Stack nested parent, child, and deeper folder headers while scrolling
Enhance the built-in file explorer DOM without vault scans or settings
disambiguation: Not a replacement file explorer; it only decorates Obsidian's built-in one with sticky headers.
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian community plugin directory, so it currently requires manual installation; the plugin has no settings, commands, or network activity.
intentEvidence: Works with the existing file explorer instead of adding a separate view.
problem: In a large vault, scrolling the file explorer makes it easy to lose track of which nested folder you are currently inside.
summary: Adds VS Code-style sticky folder headers to Obsidian's built-in file explorer, pinning expanded parent folders while you scroll.
